tools.name: inspect_text
tools.title: Inspect supplied text
tools.description: Count lines in supplied literal text. Use for offline text inspection; returns a count without reading files, starting software or accessing a network. Use describe_profile for supported-scope guidance.

text.description: Literal text to inspect, not a file path.

lines.description: Line count including a final unterminated line.

tools.name: describe_profile
tools.description: Describe this synthetic text-only profile and its limits. Use before inspection when scope is unclear; returns guidance only. It cannot start native software or inspect files. Use inspect_text to count literal text lines.
